title: 검은 갈대밭 · 부서진 후광
purpose: Revised art-direction concept for a tattoo artist; not a Roblox runtime screenshot
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an entirely NEW original 16:9 landscape concept art for a surreal Roblox learning world designed for an adult tattoo artist. Art direction title: BLACK HALO / a quiet profane sanctuary in a reed marsh. This is an uncompromising, extreme CYBER-GOTHIC BLACKWORK PIXEL ART landscape, not a cozy fantasy meadow. The visual language is dense ornamental blackwork tattoo silhouette, sharp thorn geometry, liquid chrome and biomechanical abstraction, interpreted as original environmental architecture. Ground-level wide perspective from a broken black basalt footpath through soot-black and dark antique-gold reeds beside an almost black mirror lake. A few tiny brutalist open shelters, not cozy wooden cottages, are embedded in the marsh. Monumental unique focal structure suspended over the lake left of center: an asymmetrical vertical spiral of interlocked vertebra-like METALLIC mechanical segments, enormous curved scythe thorns, fine barbed filigree and cables, bending around an obliquely tilted BROKEN white-chrome annulus with a completely empty dark center. The spiral's negative silhouette is dramatic and original, not an eye, hand, character, crucifix, deity, logo or existing tattoo design. Torn black ornamental filaments hang and branch into the sky; small separated chrome fragments float quietly. A huge distant blood-red sunset disc is partially eaten by a sheer black monolith on the RIGHT horizon, independent from the sculpture. Sky is bone-white/ashen gray with oppressive black cloud bands and very sparse cobalt glitch fissures; red sunlight creates a thin long reflected wound of color on the unbroken dark lake. Reed plumes catch pale platinum and antique gold edge light. Visceral, sacred, uncanny, sinister, hypnotically still, editorial and artistically aggressive. Push the forms and contrast hard: a visually extreme silent sanctuary, enough empty water and sky to let the giant blackwork silhouette read at a glance. Genuine fine pixel art with visible deliberate pixel clusters, hard stepped outlines, dithered mist, crunchy 1990s computer-game texture and chrome pixel highlights; avoid smooth rendered concept painting. Do not make a safe generic floating geometric portal, a diamond frame, purple pastel dreamscape, neon cyberpunk city, fairy-tale village, neon sign, or cartoon gothic castle. No text, no desktop UI, no watermark, no eyes or hands, no blood or bodily injury, no photo collage, no imitation of any named artist or identifiable artwork. The reference artwork's image pixels, recognizable composition and branded OS wallpaper are not used. Original composition and all original environmental forms. Deliver only the landscape image.
referenceTreatment: Mood analysis only. No supplied reference image pixels, OS wallpaper, UI, eye or hand imagery copied, extracted, embedded or distributed. No named artist or existing tattoo design imitated.
